svg.title: Unseen compromise stays outside responder knowledge
svg.desc: Separate responder display and retrospective dossier inset with a hard gutter. The reader may see both, but no sightline or overlay should give the responder the inset's later knowledge. Visual distinction: A firm source edge with incomplete outer brackets. The blank gutter marks the limit of review, not destruction or proof of absence.
